title: Galaxica
blurb: Arcade space shooter. Six bosses, fourteen power-ups, a daily seed, and a gamepad if you have one.

title: Squeeze
blurb: Puzzle platformer built on one trick: swap between big and small to smash blocks, hit plates and fit through gaps.

title: Pinprick
blurb: A dodge-only bullet hell with a tiny hitbox. Hold slow-mode, graze the bullets, survive five minutes.

title: Hairline
blurb: A one-button runner. Jump onto platforms as thin as four pixels, with frame-perfect timing.

title: Gravity Garden
blurb: An orbital sandbox. Drop stars, planets and black holes, then watch life bloom, evolve and die.

title: Powder Lab
blurb: A falling-sand alchemy lab. Pour thirty elements together and discover fifty-three reactions.

title: Tidewater
blurb: Move the moon to change the tide. Sail under low bridges and over sandbars to collect the pearls.

title: Loom
blurb: A rhythm game on a loom. Every note you hit stitches a mirrored cross-stitch cloth.

title: Moth Mail
blurb: Steer a swarm of moths across a night city. Pick up letters, deliver them to lit windows, dodge bats and owls.

title: Cairn
blurb: Stack stones on a windy cliff. The taller the cairn, the harder the wind blows.

title: Tantrum
blurb: A crayon bullet-hell against a giant toddler. Survive every mood until he falls asleep.

title: Ant Kingdom
blurb: Run an ant colony. Mark tunnels to dig, drop sugar, and survive winters, beetles and spiders.

title: Peg Song
blurb: Pachinko with a piano. Every peg is a note. Clear the brass pegs and write the tune as you go.

title: Switchyard
blurb: Flip rail switches to send each train to the depot that matches it, before they collide.

title: Chirp
blurb: You are a bat in the dark. Chirp to see the cave by echo, eat moths, and find the way out.

title: Floe
blurb: A penguin on sliding ice. You only stop at rocks and snow, so plan each slide to reach the igloo and catch every fish.

title: Brass Pinball
blurb: A Victorian parlour pinball table. Ring the bell, sink the saucer three times for multiball, and chase the missions on the backglass.

title: Ripple
blurb: Drop pebbles in a pond. The ripples push paper boats into their moorings, around rocks, currents and a whirlpool.

title: Cauldron
blurb: Catch falling ingredients in the order the recipe asks and dodge the rest. Each potion you brew gives a power.

title: Snail Rocket
blurb: Strap a snail to a rocket and hold to boost. Bounce off mushrooms and balloons, grab lettuce, and upgrade in the garden shed.

title: Hedgerow
blurb: Turn the hedge tiles until every gravel path in the garden joins the gate. Then watch the hedgehog walk the whole maze.

title: Deepdig
blurb: Drill down through hand-coloured rock strata. Haul ore up to sell, refuel and upgrade, and dig out the relic at the core.

title: Sneeze Heist
blurb: Sneak past the guards' torches to grab the gems, but your nose itches. Hold it in, or sneeze on purpose to lure guards away.

title: Bramble
blurb: Steer a growing thorny vine and close loops around flowers to harvest them. Dodge the gardener's shears.

title: Rube Garden
blurb: Place ramps, planks, springs and fans in a glasshouse so one drop of water from the tap reaches the flowerpot.
